spanish: Todo macho en hijos de Aarón la comerá; estatuto de siempre a generaciones de ustedes de ofrendas de fuego de Jehová; todo el que tocare en ellas será santo.
grammarChanges: Replaced "desde" with "de" for the partitive מ (from the fire-offerings), removing the temporal-starting-point reading flagged by the auditor.
Replaced "se santificará" with "será santo" for qal יקדש (be/become holy), removing the causative-plus-reflexive santificar stem shift flagged by the auditor.
readerNote: Kept "ellas" to agree with the feminine Spanish noun ofrendas, even though the Hebrew suffix בהם is masculine plural.
